name: Coreo Agate
source: A cute young girl and the daughter of the leader of a former band of thieves that now hunts beasts and helps Cactus protect the village.  She has a crush on Cactus and constantly tries to get him to agree to take her as his girlfriend.  Despite her upbringing (or perhaps because of it) she is innocent of the darker side of life.
